questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks only.
Trucks are entering the highway.
A steep hill is coming.
Trucks have the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is coming.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black symbols. They tell drivers about dangers ahead. This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming. You should slow down and be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: When you pass a parked car, what should you do?

options.text: Be ready for the driver to open the door.
Speed up.
Brake hard.
Expect the driver to wait until you pass before opening the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for the driver to open the door.
questions.explanation: When you pass a parked car, the driver may open the door at any time. Stay alert and be ready for this. Drive slowly and carefully near parked vehicles.

questions.question: Your wheels leave the road edge. What should you do first?

options.text: Turn the steering wheel slightly left to get back on the road.
Hold the wheel firmly, take your foot off the gas, and brake gently.
Brake hard and turn the wheel sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the wheel firmly, take your foot off the gas, and brake gently.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, hold the steering wheel with both hands, release the gas pedal, and brake gently. Wait until you slow down before trying to return to the road. Do not turn the wheel sharply. This can cause you to lose control or cross into other lanes.

questions.question: A driver license is a:

options.text: Right, not a privilege.
Privilege, not a right.
Legal requirement.

questions.correctAnswerText: Privilege, not a right.
questions.explanation: A driver license is not a right. It is a privilege you must earn and keep.

questions.question: When driving to a place you don't know, you should:

options.text: Follow road signs to find your way.
Plan your trip before you leave.
Only know roughly where you are going.
Always choose the most direct route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Plan your trip before you leave.
questions.explanation: Always plan your trip before you drive. Check a map to know where you are going. Do not start driving without knowing your route.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used as a traffic signal.
It means the same as a yellow traffic light.
You may turn in the direction of the arrow.
A green arrow will appear next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a yellow traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.question: Alcohol is a:

options.text: Stimulant.
Antihistamine.
Depressant.

questions.correctAnswerText: Depressant.
questions.explanation: Alcohol is a depressant. It slows your thinking and makes your reactions slower and less sharp.

questions.question: An oncoming driver leaves their high beams on. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight ahead down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver does not dim their lights, look toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded and helps you stay on course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: After passing a vehicle, when can you move back to the right lane?

options.text: When you are one car length ahead of the passed vehicle.
When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
When you are 50 feet ahead of the passed vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you can see both headlights of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Only return to the right lane if you have enough space. When you can see both headlights of the vehicle you passed in your rearview mirror, there is enough distance to safely return to the right lane.

questions.question: When driving, you should look ____ ahead of your vehicle.

options.text: 60 seconds
45 seconds
15 to 20 seconds
10 seconds

questions.correctAnswerText: 15 to 20 seconds
questions.explanation: Look 15 to 20 seconds ahead of your vehicle. Watch for cars slowing down, turning, or entering and leaving the road. This helps you avoid sudden stops or turns.

questions.question: If a traffic light shows both red and a green arrow, can a driver turn in the direction of the arrow?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: A driver may turn in the direction of a green arrow after yielding to other traffic. The red light does not stop the turn.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow centerline mean?

options.text: Passing is not permitted.
Passing on the right is permitted when the way ahead is clear.
Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing on the left is permitted when the way ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow centerline on your side means you can cross it to pass other vehicles if the road ahead is clear.

questions.question: For drivers age 21 or older, what is the illegal blood alcohol level?

options.text: 0.05 percent
0.08 percent
0.02 percent
0.1 percent

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent
questions.explanation: For drivers age 21 or older, the legal limit is 0.08 percent blood alcohol. Driving with this level or higher is illegal and dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.
No passing zone.
Work zone ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that construction work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs in the work zone.

questions.question: You are waiting in the intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights to tell drivers to let you through.
Drive around the rear of a car blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another car hits you from behind, this keeps you from being pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, what should drivers do?

options.text: Drive faster to get to your destination quickly.
Get closer to the car in front of you.
Stay farther away from the car in front of you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther away from the car in front of you.
questions.explanation: In wet weather, increase the distance between you and the car ahead. This gives you more time to stop.

questions.question: A child is about to run into the street. What should you do?

options.text: Start to slow down.
Flash your headlights.
Sound a sharp blast of your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound a sharp blast of your horn.
questions.explanation: Sound a sharp horn blast to warn a child or any pedestrian who is about to step into the street in front of your vehicle.

questions.question: Oncoming cars are to your left and parked cars are to your right. Which way should you steer?

options.text: Closer to the oncoming cars than the parked cars.
Closer to the parked cars than the oncoming cars.
Down the middle between the oncoming and parked cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Down the middle between the oncoming and parked cars.
questions.explanation: When trapped between oncoming cars and parked cars, steer down the middle to stay equally away from both.

questions.question: The road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line next to your lane. When can you pass?

options.text: Only in an emergency.
Only on an expressway.
When traffic ahead is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: When traffic ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line on your side means you can pass if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: You are in a no passing zone and another car is passing you. What should you do?

options.text: Pull off the road.
Keep your speed and position the same.
Slow down so the other car can safely return to your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down so the other car can safely return to your lane.
questions.explanation: Slow down to help the passing car return to your lane safely. This helps everyone avoid hazards ahead.
